description: Redacts secrets in text you ALREADY HAVE (for example before pasting logs into an issue, ticket, chat message or commit message) and returns the redacted copy with a findings summary. Honest limitation: the text you pass as the argument is already in the model context, and calling this tool does not remove it from there; it only produces a safer copy to share outward. To avoid putting a secret into the context at all, use redact_file with a path instead. Heuristic: can miss custom formats.

text.description: Text to redact. NOTE: this text is already in your context; see the tool description.

name: redact_text
title: Redact text already in context
